title: WalletCreated v1
description: Domain event emitted when a wallet is created. Shared JSON contract between the Java Write Side and the TypeScript Read Side; not a compiled class.

eventType.description: Past-tense domain event name, independent of any internal Java class name.

eventVersion.description: Contract version, used to teach contract evolution.

walletId.description: Free-form non-empty wallet identifier (not a UUID format).

ownerId.description: Free-form non-empty owner identifier (not a UUID format).
